queries.query_text: microbiome modulation immune checkpoint inhibitor solid tumor phase III randomized controlled trial

Are there any completed or ongoing large-scale Phase III randomized controlled trials evaluating the efficacy of microbiome-based interventions (such as FMT, probiotics, or postbiotics) in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors for patients with solid tumors?

usable_content: The supplied text explicitly addresses the status of large-scale trials in the section 'Large-scale clinical evidence, meta-analytic synthesis, and long-term safety follow-up.' It states that 'as of late 2025, no completed Phase III randomized trials have yet confirmed a reproducible survival benefit of microbiome-based interventions in oncology.' The authors note that current evidence relies on Phase I/II trials (e.g., FMT studies in melanoma showing ~40% response rates in refractory patients) and meta-analyses of these smaller cohorts. The text details specific ongoing or completed early-phase trials, such as NCT03353402 and NCT03341143 for FMT, and Phase I trials for engineered live biotherapeutics like SYNB1891 and MRx0518. It also highlights a pooled analysis of eleven interventional studies (>800 patients) showing improved objective response rates but notes moderate heterogeneity. Furthermore, the text provides extensive mechanistic data on microbial metabolites (SCFAs, tryptophan derivatives, bile acids) and their context-dependent effects on immune cells (CD8+ T cells, Tregs), which serves as the biological rationale for why such Phase III trials are being pursued despite the current lack of definitive clinical proof. 该研究为截至 2026 年 6 月 15 日的系统综述与荟萃分析，纳入 106 项研究（76 项抗生素、15 项益生菌、15 项 FMT）。关于 FMT，作者明确指出纳入的研究设计'主要为 1/2 期临床试验或探索性研究，仅有少数采用随机对照设计（1 项）'，且未报告任何完成的 III 期试验主要结局数据。关于益生菌，纳入研究由'回顾性队列调查和前瞻性早期临床试验'组成，结论部分强调'当前证据仍不足以证明在前瞻性试验或选定研究环境之外常规实施的合理性'，并指出'需要在更大规模、高质量的研究中进一步验证'。关于抗生素，绝大多数为回顾性队列设计。作者搜索了 ClinicalTrials.gov 及 ASCO/ESMO 摘要，未发现已完成的 III 期 RCT 主要数据。
